description: This file defines classes related to warning reporting categories, including handling long plugin states, long invoke messages, and flow control metrics within the Thunder namespace.

classes.name: TooLongPluginState
classes.description: Represents the state of a plugin that has been active for too long, including serialization and analysis methods.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeMessage
classes.description: Represents a message that has taken too long to process, supporting different message types and serialization.

classes.name: FlowControlQueueSize
classes.description: Monitors the size of a flow control queue, with no serialization logic.

classes.name: FlowControlJobTime
classes.description: Monitors the time taken by flow control jobs, with no serialization logic.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes and sets internal state based on input parameters for warning conditions.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes class data into a buffer for transmission or storage.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes class data from a buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string describing the warning or state.
